narrative.overview:
iiisland's public page is a drawing sheet for the Mac's top edge. Warm drafting paper, graphite ink, a single blueprint-blue pencil, a sage screen field and a pale index field carry the composition. The live notch sits on the sheet at 1:1 with blue dimension lines measuring it; a title block carries the headline, the deck, the download stamp and the platform specs; a pinned reference print of the app's ink illustration anchors the right margin. The page is not a product photograph and not a floating card stack — it is a measured drawing where one object is alive.

The system's voice is quiet and precise. Hairlines do the structural work that shadows do on other pages. Type is the native macOS voice (SF / PingFang), set at measured steps; the only soft, shadowed object is the product itself. The blue is a pencil mark, a dimension, an action and the mandated issue stamp, never a decorative wash. Sections read as sheets in a set: lyrics as a lyric index, size as a 1:1 detail, players as a schedule, installation as notes, the release as a stamped issue.
keyCharacteristics: Warm drafting paper (#efede5) as the ground; graphite text; one blueprint blue; sage and pale-blue fields that own whole regions.
A 24/48 drawing module, 1px hairlines, title block, sheet references A-01–A-07, crop ticks and 1:1 dimension lines.
The island is the only soft, shadowed object and the only thing on the sheet that moves.
Native system type, no webfont; the platform's own face is the brand voice.
Square instruments (2px page controls, square toggles, 1px rules) against the one pill (the lyric capsule) and the one notch (the island).

rules.name: The Blue Pencil Rule
rules.body: Blue is a mark or an action: dimension lines, active indices, the download stamp, focus. It never becomes a decorative field except the mandated issue stamp. If blue is doing neither measuring nor acting, remove it.

rules.name: The Paper Field Rule
rules.body: Field colours own whole regions. Sage is the hero screen and the size detail; pale blue is the player schedule; paper is everything else. No coloured cards scattered over paper, no coloured border-left stripes.

rules.name: The Intentional Warmth Rule
rules.body: The warm paper ground and the two-axis drafting grid are the direction, not an AI-cream default; the 404 inherits the same paper. The functional barcode in the issue stamp is a print element, not decorative stripes.

rules.name: The Native Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the system stack everywhere, including display. It is a commitment to the product's platform, not an unresolved font choice; do not introduce a webfont.

rules.name: The Measured Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are 11px, tracked, and factual: A-02, SCALE 1:1, 440 × 266, 0.8.22, 版本. They sit in margins, title blocks and dimension lines; they never become a kicker above a heading.

rules.name: The One Clear Step Rule
rules.body: The headline is the largest text; displays step down once; titles step down again. Do not let a section heading meet or exceed the headline.

rules.name: The Only Living Element Rule
rules.body: The island is the only object on the sheet that both casts a shadow and moves. Everything else is printed, ruled or flat. If a panel starts to float, it has stopped being part of the drawing.

rules.name: The Square Instrument Rule
rules.body: Page controls inherit the drawing's square corners; only the product and its lyric pill are allowed to be soft. Adding a rounded card to a paper section is a shape violation, not a style preference.

dos: Do keep the warm paper ground, graphite ink and the single Blueprint Blue; use Blueprint Ink for small blue text on sage or pale fields.
Do draw with 1px hairlines, the 24/48 module, title blocks, sheet references, dimension lines and crop ticks; the drawing is the layout.
Do keep the island as the only shadowed, soft, moving object, and the lyric capsule as the only pill.
Do keep the native system stack as the display and body voice; the product is a Mac app and the page should sound like the Mac.
Do keep the headline the largest type, displays one step down and labels at 11px/tracked.
Do label the demo as a web interaction with no audio and the songs/lyrics/covers as original synthetic content.
Do preserve keyboard focus, the skip link, reduced-motion static states, the no-JS reading path and the 44px+ controls.
donts: Don't turn paper sections into rounded cards, add icon tiles, gradient buttons, glass/blur, coloured left borders or hard offset shadows.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading; the title block field labels and sheet references belong in margins and title blocks, never as a generic eyebrow.
Don't add a webfont, a second accent, a dark hero field, a fake app screenshot, invented testimonials or benchmark claims.
Don't scatter blue as decoration or let it own a field other than the mandated issue stamp; blue must measure or act.
Don't give every section the same entrance animation or a floating shadow; one authored moment (the sheet plotting in) is enough.
Don't "fix" the intentional paper palette, the drafting grid or the functional barcode by replacing the world; they are the system.
Don't use the island's rounded, shadowed language on ordinary panels; that language belongs to the product.
